📄 Meeting Notes · Input
─────────────────────────────────
Proposed Inventory Application
Modernization Extension

Extend the existing Inventory Application
Angular 15 upgrade to include automated
bundle-size analysis, WCAG accessibility
checks, and Node.js 20 build compatibility.

The build should fail when the production
bundle exceeds the agreed size limit or when
critical accessibility violations are detected.
Existing inventory workflows must continue
to pass regression testing.
